description: This file contains the implementation of EventJsonDeserializer, a class responsible for deserializing JSON objects into Event subclasses within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing deserializer instances, validating event types, parsing JSON fields, and creating event objects through a factory function.

classes.name: EventJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final class responsible for deserializing JSON objects into Event subclasses. It manages the parsing of common event attributes like revision, timestamp, and metadata, and verifies the event type before creating the event instance via a factory function.

methods.name: EventJsonDeserializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deserializer with a specified event type and JSON object.

methods.name: EventJsonDeserializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deserializer with a specified event type and JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Partially deserializes the JSON data and uses a factory method to create the full Event instance, validating event type and extracting common fields.

methods.name: validateEventType
methods.description: Checks if the JSON's event type matches the expected type, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: extractEventTypeV1
methods.description: Attempts to extract the event type in legacy V1 format from the JSON object.

methods.name: tryToParseModified
methods.description: Parses a date string into an Instant, throwing an exception if the format is invalid.
